overview: Syphilis is a preventable and curable bacterial sexually transmitted infection (STI). If untreated, it can cause serious health issues. Many people with syphilis do not have symptoms or do not notice them.
symptoms: non-itchy rash, usually on the palms and soles of the feet
neurological conditions including blindness, deafness, meningitis
diagnosis: direct detection of Treponema pallidum through a microscope
indirect methods such as blood tests
transmission: oral, anal or vaginal sex through contact with infectious lesions
prevention: correct and consistent use of condoms during sex
people at higher risk of infection should be tested at least once a year
risk_factors: gay men and other men who have sex with men
people at higher risk of infection
key_facts: 8 million adults between 15 and 49 years old acquired syphilis in 2022
Syphilis increases the risk of acquiring HIV infection by approximately two-fold
